muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is greedy tactical Go with positional heuristics: instant capture of groups in atari, escape of own groups in atari, opening book on empty board, then 1-ply simulation of all near-stone candidates scoring captures, ataris created, liberties, connectivity, eye-fill avoidance and edge penalties, with suicide filtering and safe fallback to guarantee legality.
muse_spark_1.3/002: The strategy is a fast tactical Go heuristic with full legality checking. It builds groups and liberties once, then scores every empty point for immediate capture, saving in-atari groups, putting opponent in atari, connectivity, open space, edge penalties, eye-fill avoidance and self-atari / snapback avoidance. An opening book takes empty corners on the first moves, and it passes when no move has positive value to avoid filling own eyes.
muse_spark_1.3/003: The strategy is a fast heuristic Go engine: secure fuseki with star/3-4 points, then tactical search for captures and saves, atari creation, connection/cutting, eye preservation, liberty evaluation and positional weights with Zobrist super-ko avoidance. All moves are legality-checked for suicide and occupation so a legal move is always returned.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is urgent tactics first, shape second: win captures, save own atari, put opponent in atari, avoid self-atari and eye-filling, prefer 3rd-4th line and near stones, punish blunders that allow immediate recapture, play far corners in the opening and pass only when every move loses.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is solid tactical Go with fast local search: immediate capture of groups in atari, escape of own groups in atari, star-point opening maximizing spread, then candidate generation within distance 2 of stones pruned by contact heuristic and 1-ply simulation scoring captures, liberties, atari bonus, self-atari and eye-fill penalties, edge penalties and ko-history avoidance. Only eye-filling moves trigger pass. A first-empty fallback guarantees a legal return.
